options.explanation: Wrong. 矩阵制中经理们争夺资源的 turf wars 会“增加”而不是“减少”。

options.label: B
options.text: Managers will spend less effort coordinating their work, believing that someone else can pick-up the slack.
options.explanation: Wrong. 矩阵需要付出“极高”的协调成本来平衡不同头目的指示，而不是花更少精力。

options.label: C
options.text: Role ambiguity or role conflict is very low
options.explanation: Wrong. 矩阵中的一大顽疾恰恰是角色极度模糊和冲突 (role ambiguity is high)，因为听谁的很难说清。

options.label: D
options.text: There is potential for interpersonal conflict with team members as well as with leaders
options.explanation: Correct. 团队成员之间、以及多个领导之间的扯皮和人际冲突，是矩阵制最让人头疼的缺点。

explanation: 矩阵式结构 (matrix structure) 虽然能兼顾不同维度的需求，但它打破了“统一指挥”原则，让员工拥有多头领导（比如又要向产品经理汇报，又要向职能主管汇报）。这不可避免地会导致频繁的权力斗争和人际冲突 (interpersonal conflict)。
examTip: Exam tip: Matrix 结构的最大雷区：多头领导 (two bosses) 导致踢皮球和严重的人际冲突 (conflict)。

stem: Saddiq’s company has a high degrees of centralization in its organizational structure. Saddiq has learned that a main drawback of working in a firm with centralized decision making is that it can often result in which of the following?

options.label: A
options.text: reduced creativity and innovation
options.explanation: Wrong. 集权可能不利于底层微创新，但这往往是 formalization (正规化) 的典型负面后果，对集权而言，最直接的痛点是“决策太慢”。

options.label: B
options.text: less employee job satisfaction due to the repetition of tasks
options.explanation: Wrong. 任务重复导致工作满意度低，是高度专业化 (high specialization) 带来的后果。

options.label: C
options.text: increased levels of hierarchy
options.explanation: Wrong. 增加层级 (hierarchy) 往往是集权的表现或手段，但本身不是“业务上的糟糕结果”。

options.label: D
options.text: slow response time and reduced customer satisfaction
options.explanation: Correct. 凡事都要等老板拍板，必然导致响应慢、客户体验差。

explanation: 高度集权的组织 (centralization) 中，大大小小的决定都要层层上报到最高管理层。这就导致了对局部市场变化的响应极度迟缓 (slow response time)，无法迅速解决客户问题，从而降低客户满意度。
examTip: Exam tip: Centralization (集权) 最大的两个痛点：1. 慢 (slow response time); 2. 扼杀底层能动性。

stem: A disadvantage of formalization in organization structure is:

options.label: A
options.text: Decision making is at a faster pace
options.explanation: Wrong. 这其实是分散化 (decentralization) 或简单结构带来的好处。

options.label: B
options.text: Formalized structure is associated with increased motivation and job satisfaction
options.explanation: Wrong. 往往相反，过度的正规化会让人觉得死板无聊，降低满意度。

options.label: C
options.text: Strategic decision making occurs often
options.explanation: Wrong. 这和正规化没有直接关联。

options.label: D
options.text: Reduced innovativeness occurs because employees are used to behaving in a certain manner
options.explanation: Correct. 循规蹈矩的习惯严重抑制了颠覆性的新想法和创新行为。

explanation: 高度正规化 (formalization) 意味着厚厚的员工手册和不可逾越的标准流程 (SOP)。这种体制下，员工习惯于“按规矩办事”，不敢越雷池一步，从而大幅降低了组织的创新能力 (reduced innovativeness)。
examTip: Exam tip: Formalization 弊端 = 员工变成无情的机器 (used to behaving in a certain manner) -> 缺乏创新 (reduced innovativeness)。

stem: Which of the following real-world scenarios best exemplifies formalization?

options.label: A
options.text: Zappos’ focus on allowing its customer service employees to use their own approach rather than depend on scripts
options.explanation: Wrong. 允许员工用自己的方式（不用话术脚本）恰恰是“反向”的正规化 (低正规化)。

options.label: B
options.text: McDonald’s use of standard operating procedures across the world
options.explanation: Correct. 全球统一的 SOP 是正规化最经典的教科书案例。

options.label: C
options.text: W. L. Gore’s associates organizing themselves in project-based teams that are led by sponsors, not bosses
options.explanation: Wrong. 取消老板、自发组成项目团队是偏向有机型 (organic) 或扁平化的无领导结构，正规化程度很低。

options.label: D
options.text: Yahoo’s decision to fire its CEO after incurring huge losses
options.explanation: Wrong. 董事会解雇 CEO 属于公司治理 (corporate governance) 行为，与结构维度的正规化无关。

explanation: 正规化 (formalization) 最直观的现实隐喻就是“麦当劳的炸薯条说明书”。通过极其细致的标准操作程序 (SOPs)，确保无论在世界哪个角落的麦当劳，做出的汉堡味道都一模一样。
examTip: Exam tip: Formalization = 标准操作程序 (Standard Operating Procedures / SOPs)。

stem: Organizational design is

options.label: A
options.text: the process of creating, implementing, and modifying the structure of an organization.
options.explanation: Correct. 这是组织学术语中最标准、最精准的定义。

options.label: B
options.text: primarily focused on replacing a firm’s competitive advantage with competitive parity.
options.explanation: Wrong. 组织设计的目的是维持和强化竞争优势，而不是用平庸 (parity) 去替代它。

options.label: C
options.text: a process that always functions independently of strategy formulation.
options.explanation: Wrong. 结构必须跟随战略 (Structure follows strategy)，无法独立运行。

options.label: D
options.text: primarily focused on formulating effective strategies, not implementing them.
options.explanation: Wrong. 组织设计恰恰是重在战略的“执行/落地 (implementing)”，而不是“制定 (formulating)”。

explanation: 组织设计 (Organizational design) 就是高层管理者制定、实施和修改企业结构 (structure)、流程和文化的整个过程。它的核心目的是通过构建合理的骨架，把企业的战略落地 (strategy implementation)。
examTip: Exam tip: 组织设计 = creating, implementing, modifying structure (创造、实施、修改结构)。

stem: As firms grow in size and complexity, they have a tendency and an incentive to focus on________, which can lead to inertia and even failure.

options.label: A
options.text: internal shifts
options.explanation: Wrong. 内部重组变动不是它们天生“有动力 (incentive)”去追求的东西。

options.label: B
options.text: organizational structure
options.explanation: Wrong. 聚焦组织结构本身只是手段，不是导致惯性失败的业务倾向。

options.label: C
options.text: specialization
options.explanation: Wrong. 专业化可能也是趋势，但最能体现其不思进取导致最终被颠覆危机的，是只做 incremental innovation。

options.label: D
options.text: incremental innovation
options.explanation: Correct. 沉迷于在现有现金牛业务上做微小的渐进改进，最终会因为错失颠覆性技术而失败。

explanation: 随着企业规模变大、结构变复杂，在位巨头往往会陷入舒适区并受到组织惯性 (inertia) 的制约。它们变得不愿意冒大风险，而是将精力集中在安全的、修修补补的渐进式创新 (incremental innovation) 上。
examTip: Exam tip: 公司越大越求稳。Big firm = inertia (惯性) = incremental innovation (渐进式创新)。

stem: Vanessa, a few years out of law school, and wants to open her own small law firm. Vanessa should probably adopt a(n)________ structure for the firm.

options.label: A
options.text: Simple
options.explanation: Correct. 简单结构是初创企业或小型专业服务公司（如小律所、小诊所）的标准配置。

options.label: B
options.text: functional
options.explanation: Wrong. 她还没有大到需要把财务、人事和营销分开甚至成立独立职能部门。

options.label: C
options.text: M-form
options.explanation: Wrong. M-form 至少需要多条截然不同的产品线或全球化区域市场。

options.label: D
options.text: matrix
options.explanation: Wrong. Matrix 极其复杂，小型企业用矩阵制纯属灾难。

explanation: 刚毕业没几年自己开的一个小型律师事务所，人员极少（可能就老板带一两个实习生）。这种创始人直接拍板、毫无复杂部门层级的微型业务组合，只适合最扁平的简单结构 (simple structure)。
examTip: Exam tip: Small firm (小公司/个人创业) + Founder makes decisions = Simple structure (简单结构)。

stem: Elvira is the CEO of All Things Incorporated Her company employs a matrix structure, which is the combination of the________ and________ structure.

options.label: A
options.text: functional; M-form
options.explanation: Correct. 兼具专业深度的职能线，与兼顾业务或产品聚焦的事业部线，这二者的结合就是矩阵制。

options.label: B
options.text: simple; functional
options.explanation: Wrong. 简单结构根本不存在所谓的结合问题。

options.label: C
options.text: M-form; simple
options.explanation: Wrong. 同上。

options.label: D
options.text: network; functional
options.explanation: Wrong. 网络结构更注重外部联盟和外包，并非矩阵的基石。

explanation: 矩阵式结构 (Matrix structure) 企图集齐两大结构的优点。它通常在纵向上是传统的职能制 (functional，比如研发/营销)，在横向上叠加了多事业部制 (M-form，比如具体的产品或项目组)，从而形成网格状报告线。
examTip: Exam tip: Matrix (矩阵) = Functional (职能) + M-form (事业部)。网格的横纵两个坐标轴即是这俩结构。

stem: Why is it difficult to imitate the organizational culture of firms like Southwest Airlines and Zappos?

options.label: A
options.text: Their culture reflects complex relationships with their employees, customers, and suppliers.
options.explanation: Correct. 盘根错节的复杂社会关系让外部对手根本看不透，更无法生搬硬套。

options.label: B
options.text: They produce products that cannot be copied easily because of their complex designs.
options.explanation: Wrong. 文化属于软实力，不是关于硬件产品或设计的竞争。

options.label: C
options.text: The employees in the organization themselves are unaware of the factors contributing to their organizational culture.
options.explanation: Wrong. 员工未必不知道原因，只是因为这种系统化的复杂性无法打包带走。

options.label: D
options.text: It is not commercially viable for other companies to implement the same culture.
options.explanation: Wrong. 它不是财务上划不划算的问题，而是即使砸钱你也学不来。

explanation: 西南航空或 Zappos 这样神级的企业文化之所以无法被竞争对手山寨，是因为它们建立在极度复杂的社会关系 (complex relationships) 之上。这种文化是人与人、人与公司在漫长发展中经过无数互动沉淀下来的，具有显著的因果模糊性 (causal ambiguity) 和路径依赖 (path dependence)。
examTip: Exam tip: 文化难被模仿的根本原因 = 社会复杂性 (social complexity) + 路径依赖。
